section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1998
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1998 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A) 1.2.4 The incidence of Accidental Deaths increased by 10.5 per cent at national level. However, Bihar State reported the significant increase of 47.1 percent in Accidental Deaths during the year as compared to the previous year. The other States & UTs which reported higher increase were A & N Islands (38.1%) and Chandigarh (31.0%) compared to the previous year.
